exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Love the energy, Tasha, but neither works as planned. (1) Asking staff for 5-star reviews: reviews from employees without a clear disclosure are deceptive under the FTC's rules, and asking only for 5 stars is review gating. Instead, invite patients after their visits to share honest feedback, and staff can share the opening post. (2) Jordan: filming real patients needs each patient's signed MC-7 in advance, and Jordan has to disclose the paid relationship (#ad / 'paid partnership') clearly in every post. Film before opening with staff and actors and it works. Happy to help plan it.
